description.narrative: Projektet har som syfte att bidra till en välfungerande arbetsmarknad och samtidigt stödja yrkesförberedande utbildningar för ungdomar och unga människor.

The overall objective of the project is to contribute to a well-functioning labour market & to support skills development & employment for youth in Cambidia. Specific objectives are (1) Coordination & support the implmentation of the National Youth Strategy & the program plan, (2) Strenthening & further development of NEA, (3)Actions to support skills development & entrepreneurship.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2017Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Implementation and achievement of results have generally been good. The National Employment Agency (NEA) has strenghtened its capacity. The quantitative indicators on, for example number of youth receving employment guidance, job-seekers registered or job-vacancies registered, widely exceeded set targets (cf. result register below for actual figures). Within the Internship Programme, NEA, AF and HRINC, a private partner, cooperated very well. AF sees it as likely that NEA and HRINC will find ways to cooperate even beyond the scope of the project.
The three Job Centres in Takeo, Kampong Cham and Kampong Thom are established and operational. The financing of the Job Centres in Takeo and Kampong Cham has been taken over by the Cambodian government. To ensure the sustainability of the Youth Centres in same localities, more work with the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports (MoEYS) needs to be done.
